## 更新内容

- 修复技术方案导出 Word 时自定义多级目录标题样式异常的问题。
- 支持目录树标题和正文 Markdown 标题按 1–9 级目录层级写入 Word。
- 修复五级及以上标题被错误降级为较浅层级样式的问题。
- 将客户端版本号更新至 `0.7.7`。

## What's Changed

- Fixed incorrect heading styles for custom multi-level technical plan outlines when exporting to Word.
- Added consistent 1–9 level heading mapping for both outline-tree headings and Markdown headings in Word exports.
- Fixed level-five-and-deeper headings being incorrectly downgraded to a shallower heading style.
- Updated the client version to `0.7.7`.
